root_cause.text: An incorrect logical AND (`&&`) operator instead of a logical OR (`||`) in `mgmt_add_adv_patterns_monitor_complete` prevented the execution of `mgmt_pending_valid` when the status was not `-ECANCELED`, causing a pending command to be freed via `mgmt_pending_free` without first being unlinked from the pending list.

bic_trace_step.reason: The commit introduces the vulnerable line `if (status == -ECANCELED && !mgmt_pending_valid(hdev, cmd))` in `mgmt_add_adv_patterns_monitor_complete`. This uses the incorrect logical AND (`&&`) operator instead of the logical OR (`||`) operator, which prevents `mgmt_pending_valid` from being executed when the status is not `-ECANCELED`, leading to the described use-after-free vulnerability.
